retrieval.supabaseProject: ask-docs (project reference kept out of this public repository; operators resolve it from the Pages production secret SUPABASE_URL)
retrieval.sharedProjectWarning: The same Supabase project and public schema also hold five tables unrelated to documentation (names intentionally not recorded here). Migration work is additive and limited to documentation objects; never alter, drop or migrate tables outside documents/document_chunks and the search_docs functions.

documents.columns: id bigint identity PK, file_path text UNIQUE, title text, url_path text, updated_at timestamptz default now(), content_hash text null

document_chunks.columns: id bigint identity PK, document_id bigint FK documents(id), content text, chunk_index int, embedding vector(1024), created_at timestamptz default now()

retrieval.rls: Both tables: RLS enabled with a SELECT policy for role public using (true).
rpc: public.search_docs(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, similarity_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.3)  -- used by the legacy handler; filters 1 - cosine distance > threshold, orders by distance, limit match_count; returns (id, content, file_path, title, url_path, similarity)
retrieval.rollbackRule: Both search_docs overloads, both tables and their current rows stay callable and unmodified until a release explicitly retires them, so the legacy handler (deployment 2efbe4c4) keeps working after any candidate change.

baselineDefects.evidence: GitHub Actions 'Index Documentation' run 29719477193 (7b6ef85, 2026-07-20) reported success but logged 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint documents_file_path_key' for every existing document and 'Indexing complete! 70 files, 0 chunks indexed'. The upsert in scripts/index-docs.ts has no onConflict target, so existing rows can never be updated.
baselineDefects.impact: Production retrieval still serves pre-PR #3 text: 29 indexed documents contain the legacy https://apertis.ai/token route (quick-start included) and 7 contain fixed model-count claims. 7 rows are stale paths of pages later renamed to .mdx (claude-code, cline, cursor, goose, kilo-code, opencode, roocode); /installation/kilo-cli is not indexed.
baselineDefects.consequence: Live Ask Docs answers are not a parity oracle for candidate retrieval. Fixing the legacy indexer on main triggers a production reindex through the workflow and is outside #5.

baselineDefects.evidence: scripts/index-docs.ts globs docs/**/*.md and docs-api/**/*.md only.
baselineDefects.impact: Nine .mdx integration pages were never indexed from their current source.
